title: Egg Drop With 2 Eggs and N Floors
goal: Find the minimum worst-case moves to determine the critical floor using two eggs.
strategy: With m moves, decreasing drop gaps can cover m+(m-1)+...+1 floors. Increase the move count until this triangular coverage reaches n.
